node.statement: Internal algebra identity for the closing estimate, not relying on sibling 1.4.3.2: from q=(sum_{j in B} a_j^+ p_j - sum_{j in N} a_j^- p_j)/(1-sigma_g), m_B*b=sum_{j in B} a_j^+ b_j, m_B=(1-sigma_g)+nu, and nu=sum_{j in N} a_j^-, direct subtraction gives (1-sigma_g)*(q-b)=sum_{j in B} a_j^+*(p_j-b_j)+sum_{j in N} a_j^-*(b-p_j).
